# Why download it❤️ ?
 **You have a potato pc ? This modpack is made for YOU !**

**It can be used as a template for your modpacks. Just credit me :)**

 - [Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium)

# It's doesn't lag ⚠️ !
**This test are made with a Nvidia GeForce RTX 3050 Ti Laptop💻 and 14 chunks of render distance**

![My fps without shader](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/37841e56e0215b6fe921c8f489040dca8877d63b.png)

![My fps with shader](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0ad10447809c731a2b9d9027992d6638a05feec9.png)
My fps with shader : **~ 120 fps**
